title: Caregiver return & flexible onboarding: 30–90 day plan
content:
Purpose:
To provide a lightweight, pragmatic onboarding blueprint for hires returning from extended caregiving leave (parental, elder care, medical caregiver) or for hires who require an explicitly flexible ramp (reduced hours, staggered days, remote-first caregiving weeks). The goal is a predictable 30–90 day ramp with clear signals for manager/POps decisions, documented accommodations, and low-friction HR/comms touchpoints.

Scope & audience:
- Scope: non-exec IC and junior manager roles across product, infra, and platform teams. Not a legal accommodation policy (link to legal/ADA page included below).
- Audience: hiring manager, onboarding buddy, recruiter, people-ops partner, new hire.

High-level commitments (what we promise candidates):
- Respect for a phased return: defined hours and core collaboration windows agreed pre-offer and documented in the offer package.
- Explicit first-30 and first-90 goals mapped to part-time/full-time expectations.
- Manager will run weekly 30-min check-ins (first month) and biweekly (month 2–3).
- Access to shadowing/buddy hours and asynchronous onboarding material for missed meetings.

Pre-offer / Offer-stage checklist (recruiter + hiring manager):
- Confirm candidate’s desired start schedule (days/hours/week) and any anticipated changes during the first 90 days. Document in candidate notes.
- Draft an offer addendum that includes flexible-hours agreement, expected core hours, and review checkpoints (day 30, day 90).
- Share a condensed onboarding calendar (first 2 weeks) so candidate can see meeting cadence and heavy deep-work days.
- HR: ensure benefits/KM access is available on day 1 and note any paperwork lead-times.

Pre-boarding (2 weeks before start):
- People-ops creates a personalized preboarding email: IT checklist link, buddy intro, required forms, expectation memo.
- Manager to send a 1-page team context note: current priorities, team rituals, cross-team contacts.
- Buddy assigned and offered 2x 1-hr shadow sessions in week 1 (recording allowed).

Day 0–7 (quiet launch):
- Day 0: account access validated; HR benefits walkthrough (30 min); manager 1:1 (30 min) to review flexible schedule and ramp goals.
- Days 1–3: low-cognitive tasks + systems access + walkthroughs; buddy available for shadowing; encourage asynchronous catch-up docs.
- Days 4–7: 45–60 min intro project pairing session; short asynchronous assignment to verify toolchain access.

Week 2–4 (progressive scope):
- Start of week 2: 30-day goal review (manager + hire). Clear list of 3 measurable signals for on-track: PR merged, small customer/infra ticket closed, team doc contribution.
- Provide context-focused 90-day project map with optional reduced-scope milestones for part-time hires.
- Manager schedules weekly 30-min check-ins; buddy runs 1x weekly office-hours (45 min).

30-day milestone: decision point (manager + people-ops):
- Signals to check: technical ramp, engagement with core contacts, ability to deliver on reduced-scope milestone.
- Outcomes: continue plan; adjust scope/hours; or escalate to people-ops for additional support (coaching, training, workload rebalancing).

Month 2 (weeks 5–8):
- Move from orientation to autonomy: increase async ownership and deeper code/design review interactions.
- Biweekly 30–45 min manager check-ins.
- Encourage leading one small cross-functional sync (optional for part-time).

60–90 day milestone (end of formal ramp period):
- Evaluate 90-day deliverables and performance signals. Recommended manager actions: formal 90-day review, update role expectations to full-time or ongoing flexible schedule, document agreed permanent accommodations.
- If gaps persist, create a 30-day focused improvement plan (not punitive; supports rebalancing).

Interview rubric adjustments (for caregiver-return candidates):
- Time-boxing & flexibility: allow asynchronous take-home exercises with extended windows (extra days) and optional shorter live sessions scheduled within core hours.
- Rubric emphasis: weighted more toward role-relevant problem solving and collaboration style over interview stamina. Example weight: technical skills 50%, collaboration/communication 30%, product judgement 20%.
- Manager to flag any in-person/late-evening interview elements and offer alternatives. Document agreed format in interview notes.

Manager quick-guide (practical tips):
- Start with psychological safety: explicitly say "we support phased returns" in first 1:1.
- Make meeting agendas short and send pre-read.
- Prioritize async-first communications (recordings, meeting notes, threads).
- Reduce meeting load for first 4 weeks; cluster meetings into 2–3 days where possible.
- Track workload via a shared lightweight Trello/Notion board with 3 columns: Onboarding, Short tasks, Ownership milestones.

Buddy responsibilities (recommended):
- Provide 1:1 shadowing sessions, record walkthroughs, triage access issues, invite to recurring team meetings for exposure, and be the first escalation for culture/process questions.

Accommodations & HR logistics checklist:
- Confirm formal accommodation form filed (if required).
- KMS/HW provisioning: laptop, docking, VPN, expense policy reminders.
- Flexible payroll/benefits adjustments if start is reduced FTE for first pay cycle.
- Document in HR file: start schedule, review checkpoints, contact point in people-ops.

Signals: early warning and success metrics (simple list):
- Early warning: missed access after day 3, persistent scheduling conflicts that block onboarding meetings, repeated missed check-ins.
- Success metrics: first PR/feature delivery within agreed scope, consistent attendance to core syncs, positive feedback from buddy at 30 days.

Communication templates (short snippets to copy/paste):
- Manager -> Team intro: "Quick heads-up: [Name] starts on [date] on a phased schedule. Please ping asynchronously and join our welcome chat at [link]."
- People-ops -> Candidate preboard: "Welcome — here’s what day 1 looks like and who your buddy is. If you need different hours, reply and we’ll update the plan."

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Need legal review on international caregiver policies for APAC hires — Priya to loop in Legal by 2025-03-05.
- Template: create a 1-page offer addendum template for flexible hours. (Owner: Miguel)
- Consider standardizing "core hour" bands per team (e.g., 10–2 PST) — survey managers to identify feasible defaults.

Appendix: sample 30/90 micro-goals (examples to adapt)
- IC SRE (part-time example): day 30: restore two small oncall runbooks; day 90: own one monitoring alert triage flow.
- Product PM (part-time example): day 30: stakeholder 1:1s + roadmap readout; day 90: own feature scoping for next sprint.

Links & references:
- CONFLUENCE-PO-RETURN-2025 (detailed policy)
- HR Portal: accommodations and benefits (internal link)
- Interview kit: asynchronous take-home assessment templates
